trigger: Interact with Gil in his garage.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Gil's garage hums. A diesel generator. Six red jugs. A Union Pacific jacket on a hook, a shotgun under it.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: Listen here. Shut that door. You're letting my electricity out.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: If this is about Pruitt, I said it to the nurse. Can't run the whole block off one Kubota.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: You want diesel, I want something worth diesel. That's the economy now, flyboy.

choices.text: You could just help people, Gil.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: Cash is kindling. Guns, tools, meds. That tool roll of yours? Snap-on? That's a jug.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: Good steel. Five gallons. We're square.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Four years of flight line in that roll. Don't sell it.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: I'll keep it oiled. You'll want it back. Everybody wants their tools back.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: I am helping. I'm helping me. Somebody's got to be ready when the help runs out.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: Thirty-one years on diesel at the Sparks yard. Pension's a joke now. This is my pension.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: ...One night. One. And you didn't get it from me.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He shoves a jug at you without looking. You'll carry it to Lolo.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: No. Ask me again in a week when you've done me a favor. Go on.

choices.text: The pump stickers say Maverik. Monday.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: ...The station manager was gone. Pumps were dead. I had a hand pump. You'd have done the same.

nodes.speaker: gil
nodes.text: You want to tell somebody, go ahead. Who're you gonna tell?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The generator thuds on behind you.
